analyst_view.overall: Lyon are 13th with 7 points and need a win to push toward the top eight; Lillestrom are 34th with 1 point, have conceded 10 in the league phase and have not scored a first-half goal in it. New coach Carlos Vicens won 1-0 at Lille in his first game and now has his first home match, with Monaco next on Sunday. Lois Openda is back in the squad with medical clearance after a broken fibula, though not for the full game, and the numbers no longer count him as missing; Mads Bidstrup, rested for a minor foot problem, should play but the numbers still take him off, and Tessmann is also available. Pavel Sulc, Tyler Morton, Clinton Mata and Mohamed Ouedraogo remain out (counted). Lillestrom are without Espen Garnas, with Jebara and Ranger doubtful; Austrian referee Sebastian Gishamer (about 4.2 cards a game) is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals (Lyon 2.0) and now include Openda, but they still take about 4% off Lyon for Bidstrup, whom Vicens says is fine. Sulc is still out, which stays counted, so I add only Bidstrup back and go to about 2.9.

corners.text: The numbers say 11.7 corners, 7.8 for Lyon, already up for their 38 corners in the last six. Vicens wants possession and high pressing, which fits a game spent in Lillestrom's half, but that is already what the split shows, so I stay at 11.7.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards, with referee Sebastian Gishamer close to average (4.2 a game) and both sides' recent bookings already counted. Vicens expects Lillestrom to press and fight for second balls, but a one-sided home game against a side near elimination rarely gets heated, so I stay at 3.7.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.9 shots, 19.3 of them for Lyon, built on recent games played without a natural striker. Openda's return for part of the game and Bidstrup in midfield give Lyon a bit more than those games show, so I nudge it to about 29.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.3 shots on target, already up for Lillestrom conceding 30 on target in six games. Openda, Lyon's main finisher, is back for part of the game after eight missed matches, so I nudge it to about 11.5.
